name: session-link
description: session-link: persistent lines of work across agent sessions — a context-handoff core (store, lineage, derived facts) shared by a pi extension and a thin CLI. Writes a handoff and auto-starts the next session, which can query the previous one headlessly. Portable driver model (pi / claude-code / qwen).

scripts.build: echo 'pi loads .ts directly — nothing to build'
